description: This file defines the interface and class declarations for a GStreamer Web Audio Player component within the Rialto server project. It includes class definitions for the factory and the player, along with method signatures for controlling playback, setting configurations, and managing the pipeline. The file also references various external interfaces and factories related to GStreamer, threading, and audio processing.

classes.name: GstWebAudioPlayerFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating instances of GstWebAudioPlayer.

classes.name: GstWebAudioPlayer
classes.description: Main class implementing the Web Audio Player functionality, managing GStreamer pipeline, threading, and playback controls.

methods.name: createGstWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of GstWebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: setCaps
methods.description: Sets the audio capabilities and configuration for the player.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes audio data buffers to the pipeline.

methods.name: getQueuedBytes
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes queued in the pipeline.

methods.name: stopWorkerThread
methods.description: Stops and resets the worker thread.
